description: This file contains JavaScript functions for interacting with user-related API endpoints in a frontend application. It provides methods to fetch a user's projects and basic user information via HTTP calls to a backend service, with some handling for query parameters, error cases, and response data processing.

methods.name: getUserProjects(userId, params = {})
methods.description: Fetches a list of projects for a specified user, using optional query parameters such as organization, date range, and cache settings.

methods.name: getUserBasic(userId)
methods.description: Fetches minimal information (id and name) about a user by their MongoDB ObjectId, with graceful handling if the user is not found.
